pool: Frozen calibrated-majority answer first, followed by three highest mean-calibrated-probability alternatives. No gold, labels, or another endpoint used; no case exclusion if target absent.
pair_rule: Six unordered pairs, both A/B orders. Consistent winner gets1 point, disagreement gives0.5 each. Global ties use initial pool order.
matched_control: Same four candidates and native prompt,12 unique balanced four-option orders, each candidate occupies each position3 times; plurality, ties use initial pool order.
primary: Pairwise versus matched listwise control, and frozen calibrated49 majority, target correctness and macro recall on each original backbone. Expand only if joint net benefit is supported.
scope: Same40 exposed R3 diagnosis cases per model; development only. References are not given to the head. No new source validation.
cost: Either deployed arm needs6 shared full-catalog scores plus12 new decision scores per patient. No new training, retrieval or priors.
